note: Inyo NF campground in open sagebrush off Hwy 120, 2.5 mi west of US-395 at the mouth of Lee Vining Canyon, with little shade; Lee Vining Creek runs in a tree belt below it. Bear boxes at the sites. --Claude
summary: Moraine (Inyo NF): no recreation.gov listing and FS says 'No reservations, first come-first served' (confirmed); $28 + $10 extra vehicle; 25 sites, vault/portable toilets, no potable water; closes ~Sep 27 (2026). Not waterfront kept (creek ~150-250 m away). Phone and website to replace.
flags: PHONE: 760-873-2400 -> (760) 647-3044 (Mono Basin Scenic Area Visitor Center, the campground page's office contact; 760-873-2400 is the forest supervisor's office).

WATERFRONT: not waterfront KEPT. On imagery the loop is in open sagebrush; Lee Vining Creek is ~150-250 m south-east in a tree belt. The old note's 'drive-in sites along the creek' is not borne out and was dropped.
FACILITIES: the FS page says both '25 sites with portable toilets' and 'Vault toilet(s)'; wrote vault_toilets true from the amenity line - reviewer may prefer to leave it.
STATUS: 'Site Closed' banner is the seasonal close (anticipated closing Sep 27, 2026); left open.
MAX RIG: no length posted; the old note's 'larger rigs fit' had no source and was dropped. Imagery shows open, level ground with room for a 23-ft rig.
PIN: stored 37.92977,-119.15988 matches the FS page's 37.929767,-119.159901 and sits on the loop - OK.
